description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Number' within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically in the NumberFormat wizard component. The class provides methods for configuring number formatting, including decimal precision, whether to include a thousands separator, and locale settings (though locale is not used for number formats in the implementation). It likely facilitates the creation of customized number formats for spreadsheet cells.

classes.name: Number
classes.description: Represents a number format wizard allowing customization of decimal places, thousands separator, and locale. Implements methods to format numbers according to specified settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing number of decimals, thousands separator option, and locale. Sets the corresponding properties.

methods.name: setThousandsSeparator
methods.description: Sets whether to include a thousands separator in the formatted number.

methods.name: getLocaleFormat
methods.description: Returns the format string, ignoring locale because it's not used for number formats in this context.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates and returns a format string based on the current properties, e.g., including thousands separator and decimal places.
